Job Description

Operational Resilience Senior Advisor (Information Security Senior Advisor)

Location: This role requires associates to be in-office 1-2 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office.

Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law.

The Operational Resilience Senior Advisor (Information Security Senior Advisor) is responsible for the selection and delivery of strategic network security, access control and secure transaction/messaging solutions, strategic business continuity, risk management, crisis management, operational and technology-ai resilience, and TPRM controls and solutions. Develops, recommends, and implements enterprise information security including global business resilience and vendor resilience policies, technical standards, guidelines, procedures, and other elements of an infrastructure necessary to support information security, risk management and global business resilience, operational and technology-ai resilience, and vendor resilience programs, in compliance with established company policies, regulatory requirements, industry standards, best practices, and generally accepted information security, business continuity and third party risk management (TPRM) controls.

How you will make an impact:

• Leads development and execution of risk assessment methodologies to fit business, TPRM, regulatory, and technical environment considerations;

• Leads the development of requirements, system architecture, and software design of security and risk management products and services; leads the development of strategies for discovery, evaluation and response to new networking attacks; develops security, crisis response, and TPRM incident response plans and strategies.

• Provides trouble resolution and serves as point of technical and TPRM escalation on complex problems.

• Creates presentations and seeks IT management approval and acceptance of significant resilience programs, projects and replacements or reconfigurations of major security systems serving the Enterprise.

• Sets and/or supports operational, business and vendor resilience strategy and direction.

• May be assigned to project teams for technical and subject matter expert (SME) consultation to business partners, stakeholders, vendors and developers.

• Designs & engineers comprehensive access management and network security technical solutions, resilience-related tools for plans development, execution, and customer facing, based on business requirements and defined technology standards;

• works with architecture to update technology direction & strategy.

• Develops reports supporting strategy and direction for management.

• Capable of serving as the technical merger & acquisition lead.

• Acts as a subject matter expert among peers, with manager and senior management.

• Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing with associates, team members, stakeholders, regulators, customers and vendors.

• Must be capable of providing top-tier support for 5 or more of the information security technology common body of knowledge skill sets: 1) Access Control, 2) Application Security, 3) Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Planning, 4) Cryptography, 5) Information Security and Risk Management 6) Legal, Regulations, 7) Compliance and Investigations, 8) Operations Security, 9) Physical (Environmental) Security, 10) Security Architecture and Design, 11) Telecommunications and Network Security, 12)Vendor Resilience and 12)Technology Resilience.

Minimum Requirements:

Requires BS/BA in information Technology, Business Administration, or related field of study and a minimum of 8 years’ experience in business continuity management, TPRM, systems administration and security aspects of information systems, access management and network security technologies, network communications, computer networking, telecommunications, systems development and management, hardware, software, data, and people; experience with multiple technical and business disciplines required; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

Preferred Skills, Capabilities, and Experiences:

• Certifications: CBCP, MBCP, CISSP and other advanced technical security certifications (e.g. Information Systems Security Architecture Professional, Information Security Engineering Professional, Certification and Accreditation Professional, or equivalent certifications) strongly preferred.

• Experience planning, designing, building, implementing or maturing third party risk management programs, business continuity programs, global business resilience programs or highly complex systems is strongly preferred .

• Experience in Healthcare sector is preferred.

Non-Management Exempt

Senior Associate, Business Continuity Management

As a Senior Risk Associate in Card Risk, you will support the development, delivery, and iteration of horizontal risk management programs, with a primary focus on Business Continuity Management (BCM). You will serve as a technical point of reference who bridges the gap between enterprise policy and line-of-business (LOB) execution. You will be responsible for ensuring that our resiliency strategies are not just compliant, but optimized for the evolving threat landscape of the Card business.

Key Responsibilities

Program Management & Execution

• Design and execute horizontal risk initiatives across Card, ensuring consistency in the Business Continuity program.

• Proactively probe existing processes to uncover operational risks and propose enhancements to program roadmaps and strategies.

• Consistently produce high-quality risk assessments and data-driven reports, demonstrating autonomy in judgment while knowing when to escalate complex blockers.

• Own your development journey, staying ahead of industry trends in BCM and operational resilience to act as a "beacon" for Business partners.

Influence & Communication

• Create compelling "stories" via slides and verbal briefings to influence stakeholders and leaders on risk mitigation outcomes.

• Act as a technical reference in BCM, providing guidance to Risk Managers, Plan Owners, and Plan Managers and challenging existing thinking to improve Card's stability.

• Tailor communication to diverse audiences, from technical teams to Director-level leadership, ensuring clarity and organizational buy-in.

Problem Solving & Judgment

• Participate in process assessments and participate in risk evaluations, effectively navigating ambiguity with minimal guidance.

• Analyze disparate data points across Card Risk to identify broader trends and impediments, making linkages beyond your immediate scope to drive systemic change.

• Challenge existing norms with tact, providing helpful paths to problem-solving rather than just identifying gaps.

• Demonstrate sound judgment in determining when an analysis is complete and when a risk requires immediate leadership escalation.

Partnership & Leadership

• Partner with internal and external LOB customers to jointly develop resiliency solutions that meet their specific operational needs while maintaining enterprise standards.

• Actively lead team meetings and agile standups, pulling people together to build mutuality and leverage the broader network for project success.

• Informally coach more junior associates and contribute to the team’s collective toolset and knowledge base.

Basic Qualifications

• Associates degree

• At least 1 year of Risk Management or Project Management experience

Preferred Qualifications

• Proven experience in Business Continuity, Crisis Management, or Operational Risk.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable risk insights.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, specifically in slide-writing and executive storytelling.

Manager, Business Continuity and Resilience Risk Management (System and Data Lead)

About the Role

Do you want to be part of an organization that’s dedicated to helping Capital One identify, manage, and effectively mitigate operational risk—for our customers, our communities, and our associates? Capital One is seeking an enthusiastic, self-motivated professional to join the Business Continuity and Resilience Risk Management (BCRM) team within the Operational Risk Management (ORM) second line of defense. BCRM is responsible for independent governance and oversight of Capital One’s business continuity and operational resilience practices, enabling the enterprise to respond to and recover from business disruptions.

As a Manager on the BCRM team, you will serve as the functional system and data lead, providing strategic oversight and guidance for our business continuity system of record architecture and technical requirements. You will bring a strategic capability lens to translate BCRM, ORM, and enterprise methodology updates into actionable technical requirements while advancing data ecosystem integrity. Beyond technical execution, you will coordinate and influence key horizontal partner teams, drive continuous process evolution, and champion the integration of AI and automation to modernize data capture and risk insights across both the first and second lines of defense.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Outcomes & Leverage: Identify, plan, and launch AI and automation capabilities (e.g., using LLMs, RPA, or APIs) that streamline user workflows, reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and deliver quantifiable operational leverage.

• Methodology & Requirements Translation: Translate complex BCRM, ORM, and enterprise methodology enhancements into actionable technical requirements, data schemas, and system workflows.

• Delivery Coordination, Planning, and Ownership: Act as a key liaison and strategic communicator across ORM support teams and lines of defense. Coordinate the activities of the BCRM system team, aligning the roadmap with support team planning cycles to ensure timely delivery of system enhancements and BCRM strategic goals. Oversee system configuration and usage to ensure alignment with BCRM, ORM, Capital One standards, and industry best practices.

• Data-Driven Performance & Iteration: Establish and monitor specialized system metrics (e.g., system integrity, manual intervention rates, system latency, and system health) to refine system features and optimize the product roadmap post-launch.

• Horizontal Collaboration & Influence: Build strong connections across second line of defense teams and first line partners. Connect frameworks and technical capabilities horizontally to deliver a streamlined, integrated risk experience.

• Team Leadership & Process Evolution: Promote continuous improvement and evolution of processes. Reduce roadblocks for cross-functional partners, set tactical goals for system development, and effectively prioritize competing deliverables.

Skills and Capabilities

• Analytical & Integrated Problem Solving: Exceptional critical thinking with the ability to "connect the dots" across complex data structures, system configurations, and risk taxonomies.

• Technical & Product Fluency: Strong familiarity with relational data models, product development frameworks, and the application of automation tools and AI to drive operational leverage.

• Strategic Influence & Communication: Proven ability to act as a primary liaison and strategic communicator across teams. Adept at distilling complex technical architecture, data schemas, and risk concepts into clear, actionable insights and decision points for senior leadership and core stakeholders.

• Judgment & Execution: Sound judgment and risk acumen; proven capability to manage and deliver multiple medium-to-high complexity priorities simultaneously within a standard framework.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

• At least 4 years of experience in Risk Management, Business Analysis, Systems Engineering, or Systems Architecture

• At least 2 years of experience working in Business Continuity, Operational Resilience, Operational Risk, or Technical Risk Environments

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Systems Engineering, or a related field)

• Experience applying risk management principles, risk governance frameworks, or 2LOD methodology changes to technical data models and system specifications, including leading or coordinating project delivery

• Demonstrated liaison and communication skills, including a proven track record of synthesizing complex technical architecture and risk concepts into clear insights and decision points for leadership

• Familiarity with AI-driven risk management tools, automated workflow solutions, or LLM-assisted data capabilities.

• Experience with enterprise business continuity or operational resilience software tools (e.g., Fusion, Archer, CL360)

This role is not merely about tracking compliance; it is about serving as a strategic influencer and change agent who inspires business and tech partners to think broadly about business continuity and resiliency. You will leverage a deep foundation in Business Continuity Management to ensure Capital One Banking and Premium Products remain well managed, profitable, and resilient in an ever evolving technological and regulatory landscape.

You will proactively identify and map critical technology dependencies across end-to-end business processes, analyzing their resilience to anticipate potential disruption impacts and ensuring robust recovery strategies are integrated into our business continuity framework. The Senior Manager at Capital One is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy and strategic synthesis .

The benchmark for success includes:

• Strategic Leadership: Moving beyond administrative oversight to drive divisional strategic imperatives and program enhancements.

• Fungibility & Adaptability: Being technologically adept and quick to adapt to changing landscapes, translating complex regulatory requirements into actionable business strategies.

• Effective Challenge: Providing sophisticated advice and "effective challenge" to first, second, and third-line partners (including Legal, Compliance, and Audit) regarding business continuity management lifecycle risks.

• Leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies: Use advanced tools to enhance process efficiency and drive predictive risk modeling.

• Strong Judgment: Strong integrity and leadership to act as a trusted advisor, ensuring the Retail Bank and Premium Products are protected through proactive risk consulting.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedom and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world.

The Operations Resiliency leader (Director or M7 Level) will have solid-line responsibility to the VP, Digital and Automation CGO leader and dotted-line functional reporting responsibility to our Executive Director of Digital Technology Operations, Supply Chain, & Quality (OSCQ) Solutions.

This Director level role is responsible for ensuring that all new factory builds, expansions, and major infrastructure projects are designed, executed, and commissioned with world‑class resiliency, reliability, flexibility / adaptability, and operational continuity. Along with the new factory builds, this leader is also responsible for assessing, prioritizing, and driving resilience improvements across existing Capacity Growth Office (CGO) critical factories (Tucson, AZ; Andover, MA; and McKinney, TX), in partnership with RTX Enterprise Services and other Raytheon Digital teams (OSCQ, Infrastructure, Program digital etc.). This role oversees the development of resilience strategies, risk mitigation frameworks, disaster recovery/business continuity, and operational readiness plans that safeguard manufacturing uptime from day one. This leader will work with strategic leaders to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge digital technologies, automation, and advanced data capabilities for next-generation factory operations. This leader will drive the creation of highly automated, data-driven, and resilient production systems by leveraging digital Operations/OSCQ strategies and smart factory technologies. The Director will partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Facilities, EHS, and executive leadership to embed resilient design principles, scalable operational processes, and proactive risk management into every stage of factory planning, construction, and operation.

The resiliency lead will strengthen the factory’s ability to operate reliably under all conditions by embedding risk‑tolerant design, predictive monitoring, and real-time operational intelligence into new production environments. This executive will define and execute the resiliency vision for manufacturing, ensuring new factories are built with the systems, data infrastructure, and processes needed to maintain uninterrupted operations, accelerate production ramp‑ups, and sustain long-term throughput.

This role has full ownership in defining and executing the factory automation and resiliency strategy to drive accelerated delivery capabilities and increase throughput through digital transformation and modernization. The individual will design and implement a comprehensive technical roadmap that integrates advanced technologies and digitizes operations to establish smarter, more connected, and data-driven production environments.

What You Will Do

Key Responsibilities include

• Lead the resiliency strategy for all new factory builds and factory expansions, ensuring facilities are designed for disaster recovery, business continuity, operational robustness, agility, and future scalability.

• Drive the integration of resiliency requirements into architectural, engineering, and construction plans, including utilities, automation, technology infrastructure, environmental controls, and redundancy systems.

• Conduct risk assessments and lead mitigation plans (e.g., seismic, climate, supply, utility, infrastructure, equipment, cloud, cyber‑physical systems) to ensure site selection and design decisions reduce exposure to operational disruption.

• Define and implement the smart factory strategy, including the technical roadmap for architecture and infrastructure, ensuring alignment with enterprise growth and operational objectives.

• Design and deploy advanced digital solutions to optimize factory planning, construction, and operations, integrating digital engineering, digital twin, predictive analytics, and smart factory technologies.

• Design and deploy support systems to sustain high levels of uptime and performance for Manufacturing & Supply Chain Applications, Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), automation and robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, digital twin technology, and smart supply chain systems to enhance production efficiency and enable real-time decision-making.

* Frequent Travel (50% or more) required as needed to Factory sites for Raytheon across the US. Most travel will be to visit our Capacity Growth office factory sites in Tucson, AZ; Andover, MA; and McKinney TX. Additionally, there will be travel to other Raytheon US domestic locations as business needs dictate.

Qualifications

You Must Have:

• Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum of 14 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 12 years' experience
• Experience leading and managing multiple functional teams.
• Experience in leading Factory transformation and modernization initiatives from a Digital Technology perspective.
• Experience in developing digital technology (IT) solutions/Support Models for improving Smart Factory environments in areas such as advanced automation, digital visualization, real time monitoring, and other areas for improving stability, agility and scalability.
• The ability to obtain a US DoD Top Secret Security Clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract.

We Prefer:

• Knowledge in aerospace, defense, automotive, electronics, warehouse/logistics fulfillment, or advanced industrial operations and manufacturing.
• Knowledge of digital thread, digital twin, and model-based engineering.
• Experience in developing critical support models for large-scale automation or factory modernization programs employing automation and robotics, IIOT, Data Analytics and visualization, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) while ensuring connected and safeguarded systems holding sensitive manufacturing data are safeguarded and cyber threats are mitigated.
• Experience with process optimization, supply chain management to integrate digital tools and experience with simulation and modeling tools to test scenarios and optimize processes.
• Financial accountability and management of a large multimillion dollar annual operating budget, estimating, forecasting and managing critical and strategic investments for the business unit.
• Proven ability to lead enterprise transformation across multiple manufacturing sites. Experience integrating IT and operational technology (OT).
• Experience delivering regular executive-level briefings and effective communication across all levels of the organization.

What We Offer
